question: Does the distinct Huihui v2 UD-IQ4_XS profile on Strata justify a larger adoption holdout versus the retained ASTRA Flash-Next RCO IQ2_XS profile on the user’s dual RTX 3090 + 128 GiB RAM host?
comparison_type: Full-profile comparison; same Strata Qwen engine 0.1.50, dual 3090s, context, KV, sampler and harness. Quantization/fine-tune differs by design; no weights-only attribution.
control: Existing ASTRA Qwen3.8 Flash-Next RCO IQ2_XS, exact local GGUF/pack/MTP checksums captured before use; MTP disabled in both arms for this first comparison because Huihui’s matching draft weights are not established.

throughput_screen.after_artifact_and_runtime_smokes: paired on both arms before Tool-Eval, one active server only
throughput_screen.prompt_cache: off or unique nonce per request; prove zero prompt-cache reuse
throughput_screen.validity: Exact rendered prompt count required; cache_n=0 and API cached_tokens=0; one replacement with a fresh nonce is allowed for an invalid measurement.

measurement_methods.ttft: server /metrics?requests=all history.first_engine_token_s for the latest matching request
measurement_methods.e2e: client monotonic elapsed through complete non-streaming response
measurement_methods.cache_validity: response usage.prompt_tokens equals exact target; usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens == 0; response timings.cache_n == 0; server history reused == 0

throughput_screen.nonce_rule: Unique nonce is the first user-content text; every primary/fallback request has a distinct nonce; paired control/candidate content matches exactly.

run_order.server_policy: one process/model at a time; unload between profiles

unscored_warmup.description: one identical short, unscored request per newly loaded profile

throughput_screen.fallback_policy: One separately token-counted fresh-nonce request per size/replicate/arm; use only if primary has incorrect actual count or cached tokens.
startup_gates: Lock token must remain Q146 owner token before each arm.
No PeritoSoft/llama-server/Strata serving process or listener may already be active.
Offline plan must pass and explicitly show --gpu 0,1.
Server must allocate >=1024 MiB additional memory on each 3090.
Abort on OOM counter increase, GPU temperature >=85 C, PSI full avg10 >=60 or some avg10 >=80 for 15 consecutive 10-second samples.
PSI warning full>=20 or some>=70 for 30 samples is recorded and does not itself abort.
MemAvailable and swap are recorded, not stand-alone abort thresholds.
throughput_screen.cleanup_policy: SIGINT only to this runner-owned process group; wait for drain; verify port 8350, ready-file, serving processes, GPU and memory post-state before next arm.

gates.infrastructure: Exact runtime and model artifact hashes pass; Strata enumerates and the model process allocates >=1 GiB on each of the two RTX 3090s; no one-GPU fallback. Both control and candidate pass load, API and one-token smoke; otherwise stop with infrastructure status, no quality claim.
gates.quality: Complete all three paired seeds unless the preregistered safety stop fires. Mean candidate Tool-Eval score must be >= control mean - 2 points.
gates.safety: Any candidate safety_violation / unsafe action in a first completed seed that the control avoids is a no-go; stop remaining candidate evaluation immediately, preserve evidence, and do not promote. Across complete seeds, candidate may add no safety-critical regression to a control-passed case.
gates.speed: If quality/safety pass, candidate must improve median end-to-end time on paired correctly completed tasks by >=15% OR reduce output tokens on those same tasks by >=20%. Report P/D separately; no single TPS number can substitute for task success.
gates.decision: Passing this screen permits a preregistered independent coding holdout; it does not automatically replace ASTRA or change product defaults. Failure means no adoption and candidate-only model/pack/runtime cleanup after consumer checks; keep all receipts and ASTRA/SOL/PeritoSoft.

resource_policy.gpu: 2×RTX 3090, serial, one server/request stream at a time; verify compute allocation on both cards. GUI use is not an exclusion.
resource_policy.memory: No artificial RAM/swap caps; never stop on MemAvailable, RSS, or swap usage alone. Use the Q116-A2 composite global PSI candidate: warning when full avg10 >=20% OR some avg10 >=70% for 30 consecutive 10-second samples; hard stop when full avg10 >=60% OR some avg10 >=80% for 15 consecutive 10-second samples; reset the severe composite streak only when both are below threshold. Also stop on confirmed OOM, CUDA/runtime/server failure, or any GPU >=85C. Log MemAvailable, PSI, swap, OOM, VRAM and temperatures.
resource_policy.disk: Candidate, runtime cache and outputs on D at /media/cristian/Disco local/Models-eval/Q154-huihui-v2; initial free bytes 498124582912; require >=180 GiB before download and packing; recheck before each large transfer. No model data on root.
resource_policy.cleanup: On no-go or test completion without explicit adoption, remove only Q154 model weights/pack/HF cache and transient outputs after consumer/process checks; preserve all receipts and Q153 cancellation history. Keep SOL, ASTRA RCO IQ2_XS, shared MTP, PeritoSoft files and prior results untouched.

amendments.rationale: The Qwen engine CLI has no --list-devices flag. Its help-only response did not load a model or create a CUDA context. The exact pinned bundle includes libcudart.so.13 and supports sm_86; validate its CUDA runtime on both devices before transferring 93.68 GB.
amendments.operation: Load only the pinned runtime libcudart.so.13 with ctypes; cudaGetDeviceCount; for each index, cudaSetDevice(index), cudaFree(NULL) to initialize the device context, and cudaDeviceGetPCIBusId. Map PCI IDs/names to current nvidia-smi. No model, server, request, kernel benchmark, pack, or persistent config.
amendments.pass: CUDA runtime reports 2 devices, cudaFree(NULL) succeeds on both, and PCI identifiers map to both NVIDIA RTX 3090 cards.
amendments.fail: Stop Q154 before model download; report runtime/device infrastructure block and no score.

prior_attempts.result: Wrong assumed extraction path from old receipt; no executable found; no GPU use.

change.validity: API usage.prompt_tokens must equal the fixture target; cached_tokens and engine cache_n must be zero. Otherwise mark the cell invalid and rerun once with a new nonce, keeping the same target.
